models_evaluated: OpenAI GPT store psychotherapy chatbots (4 popular custom GPTs)

links.outcome: Chatbot quality subscores for monitoring and risk evaluation section
links.effect: Monitoring and risk evaluation subscores were low at 0.67-0.75 across the 4 psychotherapy chatbots; authors conclude they failed to address essential safety functions adequately.
links.quote: Scores were low for the therapeutic orientation (subscores=0) and monitoring and risk evaluation sections (subscores=0.67-0.75).

links.outcome: Transparency of training data and knowledge base information for chatbots
links.effect: Training data and knowledge base sections scored 0 for all chatbots, indicating no transparency.
links.quote: Information on training data and knowledge base sections was not transparent (subscores=0).

unlisted_practices: Structured quality evaluation framework (CAPE) for psychotherapy chatbots covering background information, conversational capabilities, therapeutic alliance, accessibility, and privacy

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four popular GPT-store psychotherapy conversational agents using simulated personas across a novel multi-dimensional quality and safety evaluation framework (CAPE).
